title: The Ceiling on a Hotel Rate Plans Cancellation Settlement
content:
What caps a cancellation settlement on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation turns on how many prepayment lines stand on the folio and on how the folio balance compares with the prepayment still held.

## The ceiling in three cases

1. Where more than one prepayment line stands on the reservation and the folio balance is smaller than the prepayment still held, the settlement is capped at the folio balance.
2. Where more than one prepayment line stands on the reservation and the folio balance is at least the prepayment still held, the settlement is capped at the prepayment still held.
3. In every other case the settlement is capped at what the single prepayment line standing on the reservation actually collected.

The folio balance is every line posted on the reservation taken together. More than one prepayment line means 2 or more; where exactly 1 stands, the third case governs.

## The cases read side by side

| Prepayment lines standing | Folio balance against the prepayment still held | The settlement is capped at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 or more | smaller | the folio balance |
| 2 or more | equal | the prepayment still held |
| 2 or more | larger | the prepayment still held |
| 1 | either way | what that single prepayment line actually collected |

Where the folio balance is exactly equal to the prepayment still held, it is at least that figure, so the second case governs and the cap is the prepayment still held.

## Applied to hypothetical figures

A reservation whose prepayment still held is 1,000.00 USD:

- With 3 prepayment lines standing and a folio balance of 760.00 USD, the balance is smaller, and the settlement is capped at 760.00 USD.
- With 3 prepayment lines standing and a folio balance of 1,240.00 USD, the balance is at least the prepayment still held, and the cap is 1,000.00 USD.
- With 1 prepayment line standing, which collected 520.00 USD, the cap is 520.00 USD whatever the folio balance shows.
